# Retrieve the cached attraction results for San Antonio
attractions_results = get_results_from_cache(key="Attraction search results in San Antonio.")

# Search for hotels in San Antonio with the specified criteria
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="San Antonio",
    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-11"],
    num_people=3,
    stars=[3],
    budget=55,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="San Antonio hotel search results", value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on the user's preferences
filtered_hotel_results = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="San Antonio filtered hotel results", value=filtered_hotel_results)

# Find the nearest attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotel_results,
    attractions=attractions_results,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="San Antonio nearest attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Output the query summary
print("No planning needed")
